text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head over to the track where Kawakami
Princess
is waiting to train.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer! I've been waiting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh. I've been bursting with
energy
lately! So I did some thinking!
choice_data_list: What in the world was that just no...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If I take the moves I've learned from
Princess
Fighter and put my own spin on
them, they might
be useful in a real race!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Move number one is the Princess Drift!
It's one of Princess Fighter's signature
moves, where she comes hurtling toward
a corner and then makes a glorious sharp
turn!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I was hoping to make
your jaw
drop, so I've been practicing!
choice_data_list: True, that was an amazing burst of...
True, that was an amazing burst of...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, ever since I met you, Trainer,
I've been
making huge strides in my
development as a
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's impossible for a princess as
long as her
future prince is by her side!
I'm counting on your
guidance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
it's back to drifting practice! I
have to
go even faster!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to create so much friction,
it'll
light the
track on fire! Just like in
Princess Fighter!
